title: Computer Support Specialist
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Computer Support Specialist Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Recognize computer hardware and software concepts and recognize appropriate hardware and software to address an identified; Develop competency with Internet searching technology.

Apply Computer Information Technology analysis concepts by writing an analytical comparison of the various solutions discussing relative merits in terms of effectiveness of solution, ease of implementation.
Explain security implications in each organization and prepare a security policy document.
Explain which ethical judgement option is the most ethical.
Develop a computerized solution to a problem that uses different applications within the suite.
Utilize automation capabilities of the suite to create an integrated query using Structured Query Language (SQL) to retrieve information.
Identify the various components of computer network technology and describe their basic function within the context of the network.

notes: The catalog prints CIT 091 and CIT 092 with a leading zero; these were matched to closed-list CIT 91 and CIT 92 and not marked as catalog additions.
No units are printed beside the alternative CIT 128 (closed list stores 3).
The description refers to the 'Computer Specialist Certificate' while the page heading is Computer Support Specialist Certificate of Achievement.
The first outcome appears truncated in the source ('to address an identified;'); copied as printed.
'Computer Specialist' is recorded as a career from the Career Outlook paragraph, where it is named as an occupational heading.
